postCardSecret.label: Bridge secret for /api/post-card (in-app only)
postCardSecret.helpText: External GCP callers use a managed App Token (devvit_at_…), not this setting.

catalogUrl.label: Hellfall catalog URL
catalogUrl.helpText: JSON catalog for card-of-the-day (https; must be HTTP-fetch allow-listed). Set via devvit settings set.

officialHcRedditFlair.label: Official HC Reddit flair ID
officialHcRedditFlair.helpText: Flair UUID for COTD and default /post-card flair when omitted. Set via devvit settings set.

cardOfTheDayViaDevvit.label: Card of the day via Devvit
cardOfTheDayViaDevvit.helpText: Scheduler posts HC6 card-of-the-day. Pair with REDDIT_COTD_VIA_DEVVIT=1 on the Discord bot.

redditMirrorWebhookUrl.label: Discord webhook URL for #reddit mirroring
redditMirrorWebhookUrl.helpText: https://discord.com/api/webhooks/… for PostSubmit → #reddit. Set via devvit settings set.

redditMirrorViaDevvit.label: Mirror inbound Reddit posts via Devvit
redditMirrorViaDevvit.helpText: PostSubmit → #reddit webhook. Pair with REDDIT_MIRROR_VIA_DEVVIT=1 on the Discord bot.

submissionsGalleryManifestUrl.label: Submissions gallery manifest URL
submissionsGalleryManifestUrl.helpText: GCS JSON manifest for daily gallery. Set via devvit settings set.

dailyGalleryViaDevvit.label: Daily submissions gallery via Devvit
dailyGalleryViaDevvit.helpText: Scheduler reads manifest; multi-image gallery blocked until Reddit API supports it. Pair with REDDIT_GALLERY_VIA_DEVVIT=1 on VM when ready.
